name: Ojika (Japan)
description: A white field charged at the centre with the Ojika town emblem in maroon: a stylised device of a vertical bar flanked by two hooked strokes, like the character 小.
history: Municipal flag of Ojika, a town in Nagasaki Prefecture; like most Japanese municipal flags it shows the municipal emblem on a plain field.

features.role: Ojika town emblem — a stylised device of a vertical bar flanked by two hooked strokes, like the character 小
